name: request_human_handoff
description: Hand the conversation to a human support agent. Use when the user asks for a person, an agent, support staff, or a manager, says the bot is not helping, or is frustrated and wants escalation. Words for this in the supported languages: human, person, agent, representative, Mensch, Mitarbeiter, humain, personne, agent, humano, persona, agente, umano, persona, agente, mens, medewerker, czlowiek, konsultant, agent.

reason.description: Why the user wants a human: billing for charges and invoices, technical for broken products and errors, account for login and profile problems, complaint for formal complaints. Omit when the request states no reason.

details.description: Verbatim issue description copied from the request, at most one short sentence.
